EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for contacting us!
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {{lead.First Name:default=}},
Thank you for your interest in the free Flywire Agent Platform for Agents.
In order to activate your Agent Platform, please complete the following as part of our Due Diligence process:
- Flywire Due Diligence form <[[https://assets.flywire.com/documents/Flywire-Due-Diligence-Form-for-Entities-Referral-Partners.doc]]> - Confirm your ABN (for Australian companies) or send a copy of your company registration document
Once completed, send to agent.solution@flywire.com <[[mailto:agent.solution@flywire.com]]>.
Once we receive your documents, please allow 7-10 business days for us to complete the sign-up process. Our Agent Sales team will be in touch once your account login information is ready.
For any questions or support, please contact us at agent.solution@flywire.com <[[mailto:agent.solution@flywire.com]]>.
Best regards,
The Flywire Team Flywire Global Headquarters 141 Tremont Street, Boston, MA 02111 United States
